Name: Lnh's Shipshape Farm
Author: liunianhui
Description:
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]一个全新的农场，有替换版本和新增版本。 [/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]农场规整且很大，主要用于种植和畜牧。[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]农场底部有很多灌木，在春季和秋季能收获不少浆果。[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]在农场内设置很多矿车，开局就能使用。 [/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]A new farm with replacement and custom versions. [/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]The farm is clean and large, mainly used for planting and animal husbandry. [/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]There are many bushes at the bottom of the farm, and you can harvest a lot of berries in spring and fall. [/size][/color][/center]
[center][size=4][color=#ffff00]Set up many mine carts on the farm, which can be used immediately at the new game. [/color][/size][/center]
